title: SIR Epidemic Spread Simulation in a Population of 1,000
description: Simulate the spread of a virus in a population of 1,000 people using the SIR (Susceptible-Infected-Recovered) epidemiological model.

interactions.name: Disease Transmission
interactions.description: An infected person may transmit the virus to a susceptible person based on the transmission rate.

parameters.simulation_days: number of days to run the simulation (to be specified)

metrics.name: number_infected_over_time
metrics.description: Tracks the number of infected individuals at each time step.

metrics.name: peak_infection
metrics.description: The maximum number of simultaneous infected individuals.

metrics.name: final_epidemic_size
metrics.description: Total number of individuals who were infected by the end of the simulation.
